source.prompt: open source ERP that handles production and stock management
source.note: real collected answer; brand, competitors and publishers are the specs the cycle was scored with

answer.text:
ERPNext and Odoo Community Edition (CE) are two of the leading open-source ERP options that provide robust production and inventory management capabilities for manufacturers.
ERPNext
ERPNext is a comprehensive, 100% open-source ERP platform designed for manufacturing companies. Key features include Frappe:
Manufacturing Module: Track multi-level Bills of Materials (BOMs) for finished goods and sub-assemblies.
Inventory Management: Integrated stock management across warehouses, including automatic updates when items are consumed in production.
Production Planning: Build production queues based on customer orders, raw material availability, and machine capacity.
Work Orders: Central documents to manage production processes, raw material transfers, job cards, and backflushing of finished goods.
Capacity Planning: Optimize workload allocation across workstations to prevent bottlenecks and improve efficiency.
Subcontracting Management: Track and manage items sent to subcontractors, including billing and stock updates.
Customizable Reports & Dashboards: Gain full visibility into production flow, inventory status, and cost estimates.
Integration: Seamlessly connects with sales, procurement, and vendor management for end-to-end visibility.
ERPNext is mobile-friendly, customizable, and API-first, allowing integration with other systems and easy automation of workflows for manufacturing and stock operations.
Odoo Community Edition (CE)
Odoo CE is another leading open-source ERP with strong manufacturing capabilities. Key features include :
Manufacturing Resource Planning (MRP): Plan production processes, manage work orders, and track raw materials.
Inventory Management: Real-time stock tracking, automated reordering rules, and warehouse management.
Bill of Materials (BOM): Define multi-level BOMs with routing instructions for efficient production.
Quality & Maintenance: Track production quality, perform inspections, and manage equipment maintenance.
Custom Modules & Integrations: Large repository of community-developed modules for specialized needs.
Odoo CE is widely used due to its large community support, modular design, and flexibility for small to medium manufacturing businesses.
Choosing Between ERPNext and Odoo CE
ERPNext tends to have a more manufacturing-focused core with built-in modules for production planning and subcontracting.
Odoo CE is modular and flexible but may require extra configuration or third-party apps to fully match ERPNext’s production capabilities.
Community & Documentation: ERPNext has extensive manuals and active community forums, while Odoo CE has a large ecosystem with extensive resources and third-party apps.
Both systems are actively maintained open-source ERPs suitable for manufacturers needing integrated production and stock management. The choice often depends on specific industry requirements, the need for customization, and ease of deployment.
For a detailed comparison of open-source ERP software for production and inventory management, refer to recent overviews of top ERP tools including ERPNext and Odoo CE +1.
